AdminUnlockDialog.title: Administrator sign-in
AdminUnlockDialog.hint: Enter the administrator password to open the full interface.
AdminUnlockDialog.createHint: No password has been set yet. At least {{n}} characters.
AdminUnlockDialog.createNote: Remember it: without the password the full interface cannot be opened. Support can reset it.
AdminUnlockDialog.lockedOut: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
AdminUnlockDialog.tooShort: The password must be at least {{n}} characters long.
AdminUnlockDialog.storageError: The password could not be saved to disk.

OperatorAbout.supportHint: If something does not work, write to support:

OperatorStatusBar.uptimeTip: Time since the vehicle was switched on
OperatorStatusBar.tiltTip: Amber from {{warn}}°, red from {{limit}}°: the vehicle may tip over

OperatorCameras.noCameras: No cameras are set up. Ask the administrator to add them.

OperatorScreen.stopTip: Stops the vehicle at once (Hold mode). The Space key does the same.
OperatorScreen.holdTip: Press and hold until the bar fills
OperatorScreen.commandNotSent: The command could not be sent: there is no link to the vehicle.
OperatorScreen.modeRefused: The vehicle did not switch to "{{mode}}".
OperatorScreen.notRover: This vehicle is not a ground vehicle: STOP and mode buttons are off.
OperatorScreen.layoutGridTip: Show all cameras side by side
OperatorScreen.layoutPipTip: One camera full size, the others as thumbnails
OperatorScreen.pinControlsTip: Keep day/night, light and HD/SD on screen. Otherwise they show when the pointer is over the video.

OperatorShell.linkNotSetTip: The administrator sets the connection in the full interface
OperatorShell.disconnectTip: Drop the link to the vehicle. It will not reconnect until you press Connect.
OperatorShell.toOperatorModeTip: Close the full interface and return to the operator screen

OperatorWorkspaceSettings.title: Operator workspace
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.intro: The app opens on the operator screen: cameras, vehicle status and a few actions. Everything here decides what the operator sees and may do. Cameras and the vehicle output buttons are set up in the Vision panel of the telemetry screen.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.startInOperatorMode: Open the app in operator mode
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.startInOperatorModeHint: Switch off only on a service or development computer: the app then opens straight into the full interface, without a password.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.autoLock: Return to operator mode after inactivity of
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.connectionHint: The operator has no connection panel. The screen connects by itself to the link chosen here.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.connectionLast: Not fixed: the last used link is taken ({{link}}).
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.connectionNone: Not fixed, and nothing has been connected on this computer yet.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.pinConnectionNone: Connect once in the full interface first
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.autoConnectHint: On start-up and after a lost link, retrying every few seconds.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.actionsHint: STOP (Hold mode, also the Space key) is always on the screen. The rest is optional.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.allowArmHint: Always by holding the button, never by a single click.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.tiltHint: Roll and pitch in the status strip turn amber, then red.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.videoHint: Recordings are saved on this computer, in the app data folder "camera-media".
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.recordAll: The Record button records every camera, not only the main one
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.supportHint: Shown to the operator on the About page. A Telegram name such as @name becomes a link.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.passwordHint: Opens the full interface from the operator's About page. At least {{n}} characters. Kept only as a hash.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.passwordReset: A forgotten password is reset by support: the file "operator-admin.json" is removed from the app data folder, after which a new password can be created.
